errors.text_span: Оранжевата линия показва броя на разрешенията за строеж на други сгради. Тя започва през 2012 г. със стойност от 4938 и завършва през 2022 г. със стойност от 4631. Линията има следните стойности: 4938 (2012), 4674 (2013), 4323 (2014), 4382 (2015), 4685 (2016), 5562 (2017), 5774 (2018), 4980 (2019), 5860 (2020), 4685 (2021) и 4631 (2022).
errors.evidence: According to the reference, the values attributed to the orange line (other buildings) are actually those for the gray line (residential buildings), and vice versa. For example, 5562 in 2017 and 5860 in 2020 belong to жилищни (gray), not to други (orange). The orange line peaks at 5460 in 2017 per the reference.

errors.text_span: Сивата линия представя броя на разрешенията за строеж на жилищни сгради. Тя започва през 2012 г. със стойност от 4238 и завършва през 2022 г. със стойност от 8169. Линията има следните стойности: 4238 (2012), 4120 (2013), 4245 (2014), 4310 (2015), 4514 (2016), 5460 (2017), 4826 (2018), 4608 (2019), 3944 (2020), 7047 (2021) и 8169 (2022).
errors.evidence: The values assigned to the gray line (жилищни) in the machine description are actually those of the orange line (други) per the reference. The gray line's value in 2017 should be 5562 (the highest), and in 2020 should be 5860, not 3944. The reference clearly attributes 3944 to the orange (други) line in 2020 as its lowest point, and 5460 as the peak for the orange line in 2017.
The reference explicitly states that all three lines are solid and without markers. The machine-generated description does not mention line style (solid) or absence of markers.
The reference notes the data source is НСИ (National Statistical Institute), which the machine description omits.
